newsitem.title: USA: JW Charles completes stock split.
newsitem.headline: JW Charles completes stock split.

text.p: JW Charles Financial Services Inc said on Monday it has completed its previously announced three-for-two stock split.
The stock split was effected in the form of a one-half share dividend per share of its Common Stock, $.001 par value per share, the company said.
The new shares will be distributed to all shareholders of record as of the close of business on Jan. 24, 1997, which was the record date for the stock split, the company said.
The company, which has 3.3 million post-split shares, said it will pay cash instead of fractional shares.
